nuggets.text: Runnin' Bulldogs quarterback Cole Pennington is the son of former NFL quarterback Chad Pennington.
Cole Pennington threw for 378 yards on 31 completions at Wofford last week.
The Runnin' Bulldogs outgained Wofford 438 yards to 208 last week and still lost 17-13.
Kory Jones caught six passes for 135 yards at Wofford, including a 79-yard grab.
In their last meeting, in 2022, the Runnin' Bulldogs outgained Liberty 325-315 but fell 21-20.
Gardner-Webb began in 1905 as Boiling Springs High School.
Gardner-Webb is named for Governor O. Max Gardner and his wife, Fay Webb Gardner.
The live bulldog Roebuck, introduced in 2015, was named for Mike Roebuck, an avid runner, cyclist and triathlete.
MACK, an old Runnin' Bulldogs logo, once hung on a basketball backboard in Bost Gym and now lives in the Dover Library.
Former Runnin' Bulldog Gabe Wilkins won Super Bowl XXXI with the Green Bay Packers.
